'''Ryuta Suzuki''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Gold 72 from Saitam-Ken, Japan.<ref name="sm-fan" /> The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.

== 1997 World Championship statement ==

Decipher's 1997 World Finals page listed Ryuta Suzuki and said a biography was unavailable.<ref name="dec97bio">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/suzuki.html Ryuta Suzuki], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990428113418/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/suzuki.html Internet Archive]</ref>

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables; the tables do not spell out the abbreviation.
